messages:
Alex: Heading to NYC office next Wed, team of 8 for dinner after the all-hands. Looking for relaxed places near Hudson Yards / Chelsea with some vegetarian + halal options. Mid-range budget, not too loud so we can actually chat. Any go-tos?

Priya: Chelsea Market is solid  lots of stalls so everyone picks something. Los Tacos No.1 is tasty, but might be loud. Tacombi?

Dan: +1 Chelsea Market. Also Cookshop on W 18th is great for groups, outdoor seating, big-ish plates and veg options. Make rez a few days ahead.

Zoe: For halal-friendly and veggie, I like The Little Beet (fast-casual) or Huertas for tapas (talky but seats groups). If you want a proper sit-down, Hummus & Pita on 9th is chill.

Jorge: If you want something a bit fancier but not crazy: Lilia is great but long wait / pricier. For middle ground, Eataly Flatiron has options and group tables.

Alex: Thanks! Any place that can do a pre-set menu for 8 so we don't worry about individual tabs?

Priya: Cookshop has a family-style option sometimes. Could call and ask for a fixed menu.

Dan: Also check Alta Calidad (tacqueria)  they did a private group last month for our friends. Good tacos and casual.

Zoe: quick poll? foodbot, can you run a 2-min reaction poll: Chelsea Market / Cookshop / Eataly?

foodbot: Poll created by Zoe  React to vote: Chelsea Market / Cookshop / Eataly

Priya: Chelsea Market for me  easiest for picky diets.

Jorge: Cookshop if you want a quieter table.

Dan: Eataly is easiest to split bills.

Alex: Voting Cookshop. If it wins I'll ask about a pre-set menu and vegetarian platters.

foodbot: Poll results  Chelsea Market: 2 votes, Cookshop: 3 votes, Eataly: 1 vote.

Alex: Cookshop it is. Thanks team! Any tips on parking or transit?

Priya: Subway is easiest (A/C/E to 23rd/34th) or Penn / Madison nearby. Street parking is annoying.

Dan: I can call Cookshop tomorrow and ask about a fixed menu and outdoor table. Will update here.

Zoe: I'll bring a backup list of a few casual spots in case they can't accommodate 8. :thumbsup:
